- There is no competition in AI quoting for forwarders.
• Team of 12 engineers, ex-Invented Corp founders. Six pilots running with large forwarders.
Gross margin 70% on platform revenue.
short

We have 2 patents filed.

There is no competition, nobody else does this.
We have a patent pending and 3 granted patents.
We sell to CFOs at invented manufacturers; budget sits with procurement.
We are raising within two months, runway is 9 months.
